Subject: Complaint regarding conduct at Simandhar Eye Care Centre - Ms S Tapase

Sir,

Today, i.e., on Monday, 30.03.2026, my uncle, Shri Sadanand N. Rane (a paralyzed patient), visited Simandhar Eye Care Centre, 1st Floor, for a cataract operation on his eye.

As directed, he, along with his spouse and a neighbour, reached the centre sharp at 9:00 hrs. However, Ms. Sujata Tapase allowed two patients to undergo the operation before my uncle. When asked the reason for this, she stated that “his eye is not ready for operation.”

Sir, isn't it the duty of the doctor to determine whether the eye is ready for surgery ? How can a receptionist say this even without checking the patient's eyes ?

It is therefore humbly requested that the CCTV footage may kindly be checked to verify the facts. After accommodating the two patients, Ms. Tapase then allowed my uncle for the procedure.

My aunt later shared all the details with me over the phone and expressed that they were very upset. She also mentioned that Ms. Tapase herself entered a positive review on my uncle’s neighbour’s mobile phone, which is not acceptable.

Subsequently, I contacted the receptionist telephonically to understand the situation. She informed me that Ms. Tapase would clarify the exact reason. After some time, I received a phone call from Ms. Tapase. I have shared the entire conversation with Shama Ma’am on WhatsApp.
